claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Balsalazide is a colon-specific prodrug of 5-aminosalicylic acid with no meaningful cytotoxic activity at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak, non-selective antioxidant/anti-inflammatory action rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
